title: Quantum Monte Carlo in the Age of Many-Body Quantum Information
summary: Quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) methods are among the central numerical tools for studying strongly correlated quantum many-body systems, particularly in higher dimensions. As quantum information has introduced new information-theoretic perspectives and diagnostics into many-body physics, QMC methods have accordingly been extended beyond the measurement of conventional linear observables.
